accents.indian: speaks Indian English the way an educated North Indian from the Hindi belt does: an even, syllable-timed rhythm, soft dental t and d, a lightly tapped r, w close to v, and Indian vowels, never American or British. Natural and relaxed, never exaggerated.
accents.british: speaks British English with a natural, standard southern English accent, never American. Natural and relaxed, never exaggerated.
